# louppe media culler

> a free, open-source, local, keyboard-first photo, video, and audio culler for macOS. the app itself is named Louppe.

- [website](https://louppe.eu/): product overview, features, and download
- [privacy](https://louppe.eu/privacy/): app and website privacy practices
- [download](https://github.com/alexander-markin-meow/louppe-media-culler/releases): macOS releases
- [source code](https://github.com/alexander-markin-meow/louppe-media-culler): application source
- [author](https://alex-markin.com/): alex markin
